methods.title: Lifecycle-correct canonical dependency repair
methods.failure_signature: A terminal validator binds an immutable stage manifest to the wrong Git tree or cannot accumulate its evidence counters
trigger_preconditions: First exact final is immutable, pushed, clean and fresh four-way equal
Hamish supplied new direct corrective authority
methods.candidate_workaround: Bind each immutable manifest to its own lifecycle commit and correct only the counter mutability dependency.
methods.recurrence_guard: A new canonical may target only a new additive corrected final; never rerun the failed canonical or replay x1/x2 domain work.
methods.rollback: Revert only the additive correction commit while retaining every external failure receipt.

methods.rollback: No repository rollback is needed for read-only failures; retain the failed witness and its separate recovery.
